notes.subject: ועליתו
notes.rationale: 'rot bilong go antap bilong en' o 'haussel antap bilong en'; long 1 King 10:5 em i עולתו 'ofa ol i kukim olgeta' — ol tanima i no wankain

notes.subject: ruak
notes.rationale: רוח i min Spirit/win/wind bilong bodi — 'i no gat ruak i stap long em' = em i no gat win long bodi, em i jus sok

notes.subject: ol kaikai bilong tebol
notes.rationale: ves i skelim olgeta samting kwin i lukim — tebol, ol man, ol klos

translation: Na ol kaikai bilong tebol bilong en, na ol ples sidaun bilong ol wokboi bilong en, na ol sanap bilong ol man i save wok long haus bilong en, na ol klos bilong ol; na ol man bilong givim dring bilong en, na ol klos bilong ol; na rot bilong go antap bilong en, we em i save go antap long haus bilong Yahwe; na i no gat ruak i stap long em moa.

tokens.gloss: ol man i save wok long haus bilong en
na ol man bilong givim dring bilong en
na rot bilong go antap bilong en
